verses.text: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

segments.text: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

notes: 20.1 defend…: Heb. set thee on an high place

verses.text: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

segments.text: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

verses.text: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

segments.text: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

notes: 20.3 accept: Heb. turn to ashes: or, make fat

verses.text: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

segments.text: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

verses.text: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

segments.text: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up
banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

verses.text: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

segments.text: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

notes: 20.6 his holy…: Heb. the heaven of his holiness
20.6 with…: Heb. by the strength of the salvation of

verses.text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

segments.text: in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

verses.text: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

segments.text: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

verses.text: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

segments.text: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

headings.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
